glossary.definition: History Grade 10 Student Textbook 114 The United Nations has four main goals: to maintain international peace and security; to foster friendly relations among nations; to collaborate in the resolution of international economic, social, cultural, and humanitarian problems; to promote respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms; and to protect the Earth and its environment
